statement: The built-in cosec:tenant-admin holds cosec:skip-shadow on its own tenant's document only: an administrator of a tenant skips the shadow window of that tenant's document, and the policy gives no one a skip on another tenant's document, not even a platform principal it is bound to.
guards: control:ControlAuthorizationTest#a tenant admin skips the window of its own tenant's document
control:ControlAuthorizationTest#a tenant admin who skips the window still waits for approval of what the analysis cannot prove
control:ControlAuthorizationTest#tenant admin held by a platform principal does not skip a tenant's window
